header: scripts/eds-variance.ts: runs the Executive Deep Synthesis for ONE question N times (cache cleared each time) and prints how much the replies differ: the number to look at is "distinct". I use it before and after a change to the engine. EDS_STORE=rollback also uses the REAL store (SQL and all) inside a transaction that is rolled back at the end: nothing is kept. EDS_RUNS=5 npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/eds-variance.ts "question" (EDS_CACHE=keep: do not clear the cache between runs)
